items.title: Talk about the video
items.prompt: Use one or two sentences to respond to this scene: First day of school, Gattu and Chinky were all said for their new school year, and both of them were brimming with excitement to go to school.
items.sample: First day of school, Gattu and Chinky were all said for their new school year, and both of them were brimming with excitement to go to school.

ja.prompt: この場面について、一文か二文で感想を述べてください：新学期の初日、ガットとチンキーは新しい学校生活に少し不安を感じつつも、学校に行くことに胸を膨らませていました。
ja.hint: 字幕の言葉を使って表現しましょう。
ja.sample: 新学期の初日、ガットとチンキーは新しい学校生活に少し不安を感じつつも、学校に行くことに胸を膨らませていました。

zh.prompt: 請用一到兩句回應這個情境。
zh.sample: First day of school, Gattu and Chinky were all said for their new school year, and both of them were brimming with excitement to go to school.
